name: ag2-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is AG2 (the `ag2` package), a Python framework for building LLM agents. This task
covers its core: the agent turn loop, tools and toolkits, middleware, context variables and dependency injection,
human-in-the-loop input, structured output, assembly policies, and the event stream and its events.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules of the ag2 package: ag2/agent.py, annotations.py, assembly.py, context.py, exceptions.py, history.py, hitl.py, plugin.py, stream.py, testing.py, types.py, usage.py and utils.py; ag2/events/__init__.py, alert.py, base.py, conditions.py, input_events.py, lifecycle.py, sizing.py, tool_events.py and types.py; ag2/middleware/__init__.py, base.py and describe.py; ag2/middleware/builtin/__init__.py, history_limiter.py, llm_retry.py, logging.py and token_limiter.py; every module in ag2/middleware/builtin/tools/; every module in ag2/policies/; every module in ag2/response/; ag2/tools/executor.py, schemas.py, tool.py and types.py; and every module in ag2/tools/final/. Together with them, the user-guide pages website/docs/user-guide/agents.mdx, depends.mdx, middleware.mdx, structured_output.mdx, system_prompts.mdx and testing.mdx; website/docs/user-guide/tools/approval_required.mdx, tool_middleware.mdx, toolkits.mdx and tools.mdx; website/docs/user-guide/context/human_in_the_loop.mdx, inject.mdx and variables.mdx; website/docs/user-guide/advanced/assemb
